name: Trackie
description: Trackie is a New Zealand Actual Budget server image. Sign-in is OpenID Connect, and optional per-user Akahu bank tokens are encrypted at rest.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Actual identity secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Actual akahu token secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  trackie:
    image: ghcr.io/trackie-nz/trackie:26.9.0@sha256:7c13fedacc7232f10ed3ebc59374c1b2fbe42f89d04575d2838992fb9587540d
    container_name: trackie
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5006"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      ACTUAL_LOGIN_METHOD: openid
      ACTUAL_OPENID_ENFORCE: "true"
      ACTUAL_USER_CREATION_MODE: login
      ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL: ""
      ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID: ""
      ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET: ""
      ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME: http://localhost:20005
      ACTUAL_TOKEN_EXPIRATION: "7776000"
      ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET: ${SECRET_ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET}
      ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET: ${SECRET_ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET}
      TZ: Pacific/Auckland
notes: Set ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL, ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID, and ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET before startup. Those are literals in the install form. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables. Register the callback at ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME/openid/callback. Replace ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET and ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET before creating data, then do not rotate them. The shipped values are public.
